why: An entry whose path escapes the extraction root via `../` (zip-slip). Extraction must refuse path traversal before writing any file. The payload is the archive ENCODING, so the directory package here is a well-formed placeholder and make-archive.py emits the malicious tar; the driver uploads that.
notes: make-archive.py writes raw tar headers with Python's tarfile so device/hardlink/symlink entries do not need privilege and the package is not nested under a subdir.
